label: Goose
query: select id as session_id, name, working_dir, created_at, updated_at, accumulated_input_tokens as input_tokens, accumulated_output_tokens as output_tokens, provider_name, model_config_json from sessions where accumulated_input_tokens > 0 or accumulated_output_tokens > 0 order by updated_at desc
note: 对齐 CodeBurn goose.ts：sessions.accumulated_*_tokens；无 cache 列。
